analyst.summary: NFL, a government urea major, posted a much stronger profit this year, but the improvement rests heavily on subsidy timing and favourable input costs rather than a durable gain in efficiency - working capital stress (slower subsidy collections) and rising interest costs partly offset the headline gain, and returns on capital remain weak. The stock's low valuation reflects a genuinely low-quality, policy-capped business rather than a bargain, and we recommend Sell.
